Accordion: A vertically stacked set of headings that each expand to reveal a section.
Alert: An inline message that stays in the layout: a notice, warning or error about the content around it.
AlertDialog: A modal that interrupts to confirm a consequential action; it needs an explicit choice to close.
AspectRatio: Holds content, usually an image or video, at a fixed width-to-height ratio.
Avatar: A round picture of a person or organisation, with an initial on a name-picked gradient as fallback.
AvatarUploader: A round avatar with an upload control: pick an image file to replace the profile picture.
Badge: A small 20px label for a category, count or short state. Use StatusBadge for a workflow state.
BannerImageField: A form field for a wide banner image, with upload, replace and remove actions and its copy passed in as one prop.
BannerUploader: A wide banner image with an upload control, for profile and decision headers.
Breadcrumb: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy, with links back up.
Button: The one control for an action: submit, cancel, open a menu, or render a link (`render={<Link />}`).
ButtonGroup: Joins related buttons into one segmented control.
Calendar: A month grid for choosing a date or range, localised through `CalendarLocales`.
Card: A bordered surface that groups one object: a header, content and an optional footer.
Carousel: A horizontally scrolling set of slides with previous and next controls.
Chart: Recharts wrappers themed with the `chart-1`–`chart-5` tokens: container, tooltip and legend.
Checkbox: A 16px box for an independent on/off choice in a form or list.
Collapsible: A single section that shows or hides its content.
CollapsibleConfigCard: A sortable settings card that expands to show its fields: drag grip or lock, a trigger title, an optional badge and a chevron.
Combobox: A text input with a filtered list of options to pick from.
Command: A searchable command list, used for menus and command palettes.
ContextMenu: A menu that opens on right-click or long press.
DatePicker: A date input with a calendar popover; typed text and calendar picks stay in sync.
Dialog: A modal window for a focused task that does not need to block on a choice.
Direction: `DirectionProvider` sets left-to-right or right-to-left for every component below it.
Drawer: A panel that slides up from the bottom edge, mainly on mobile.
DropdownMenu: A menu of actions that opens from a trigger button.
Empty: The empty state for a list or page: icon, title, description and an action.
FacePile: An overlapping row of avatars for a group of people, with an overflow count.
Field: The wrapper that gives a control its label, description and error.
Header: The serif headings `Header1`–`Header4` and `GradientHeader`, on the sense type scale (display, headline, title, label), with direction isolation built in.
HoverCard: A preview card that opens when a pointer rests on a link.
Input: A single-line text field, 44px tall. `unstyled` drops the chrome for in-place editing.
InputGroup: An input with leading or trailing addons: icons, text or buttons.
InputOTP: A row of single-character boxes for a one-time code.
Item: A flexible list row with media, title, description and actions.
Kbd: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut.
Label: The text label for a form control.
LikeButton: A heart toggle with a count for liking a post or proposal.
Map: An interactive map with markers, built on MapLibre.
Menubar: A horizontal bar of menus, like a desktop application menu.
NativeSelect: A styled native `<select>`, for simple lists and mobile.
NavigationMenu: Top-level site navigation with optional dropdown panels.
NumberField: A numeric input with increment and decrement buttons and locale-aware formatting.
Pagination: Page-number links for moving through a long list.
PhaseStepper: A horizontal timeline of decision phases: done, current and upcoming, each with dates.
Popover: A floating panel anchored to a trigger, for rich content or small forms.
Progress: A horizontal bar that shows how far a task has got.
RadioGroup: A set of options where exactly one can be chosen.
Resizable: Panels separated by draggable handles that change their sizes.
RichTextEditor: The Tiptap-based rich-text editor and its read-only viewer, skeleton and styled content wrapper.
ScrollArea: A scroll container with thin, styled scrollbars.
Select: A dropdown for choosing one option from a list.
Separator: A 1px `border` hairline that divides content, horizontal or vertical.
Sheet: A panel that slides in from a screen edge for secondary tasks or navigation.
Sidebar: The collapsible app sidebar with groups, menu items and a trigger.
Skeleton: A pulsing block that holds the place of content while it loads; match the real layout.
Slider: A track with a draggable thumb for picking a value or range.
Sortable: A drag-and-drop list with handles and drop indicators.
Spinner: An animated indicator for work in progress.
SplitPane: A two-pane layout that sits side by side on desktop and switches panes on mobile without remounting them.
StatusDot: A small coloured dot that marks a status beside a label: success, danger, warning or neutral.
Stepper: A multi-step wizard indicator with hooks to drive the current step.
Switch: A toggle for a setting that applies immediately.
Table: A data table with header, body, footer and caption parts.
Tabs: Switches between views of the same object without leaving the page; `default`, `line` and `sidebar` variants.
TagGroup: A labelled list of tags built on Badge, in two sizes.
Textarea: A multi-line text field that grows with its content. `unstyled` drops the chrome for in-place editing.
Toast: `Toaster` and `toast()`: short messages that appear and dismiss themselves.
Toggle: A button that stays pressed or unpressed.
ToggleGroup: A set of toggle buttons where one or several can be on.
Tooltip: A short label that appears on hover or focus; 100ms delay by default.
icons: The two custom icons, `CheckIcon` and `MegaphoneIcon`. Every other icon is Lucide via `react-icons/lu`.
